info.title: RaceDay API
info.description: Race-day management API for events, categories, enrolments and results. Call POST /api/auth/login first: the session cookie is then sent automatically by the browser.

post.summary: Registers a new account as an Organiser or a Participant.
post.description:
Expects name, email, password (minimum 8 characters) and role (Organiser or Participant).
The password is hashed before it is stored. Only the two roles above are accepted.

201.description: Account created. Returns the new user's ID, name, email and role.

400.description: Invalid or missing data, or an unknown role.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

post.summary: Logs in and starts a session.
post.description:
Expects email and password. On success the server sets a session cookie
(RaceDay.Session) that identifies the user and their role on every later request.

200.description: Logged in. Returns the user's ID, name, email and role.

post.summary: Logs out and ends the current session.

get.summary: Lists all categories (for example age groups or distances) of an event. Public.

200.description: Array of categories with their distance, capacity and confirmed enrolments.

post.summary: Adds a category to an event. Only the Organiser who owns the event may do this.
post.description: Expects name, distanceKm (0.01 to 999.99) and maxParticipants (1 or more).

201.description: Category created. Returns the category including its new ID.

403.description: Participant, or an Organiser who does not own the event.

put.summary: Updates a category. Only the Organiser who owns the parent event may do this.
put.description: Expects name, distanceKm and maxParticipants. Capacity cannot go below the current confirmed enrolments.

400.description: Invalid data, or capacity lower than the confirmed enrolments.

403.description: Participant, or an Organiser who does not own the parent event.

delete.summary: Deletes a category, provided it has no confirmed enrolments. Owner only.

403.description: Participant, or an Organiser who does not own the parent event.

409.description: The category still has confirmed enrolments.

post.summary: Enrols the logged-in Participant in a category. Participants only.
post.description:
No body is needed: the participant is identified from the session. The category must have space,
and a participant can only hold one active enrolment per category. A previously cancelled
enrolment is re-activated.

201.description: Enrolled. Returns the enrolment including its ID.

409.description: The category is full, or the participant is already enrolled.

get.summary: Lists everyone enrolled in a category. Only the Organiser who owns the event may do this.

403.description: Participant, or an Organiser who does not own the event.

get.summary: Lists all enrolments made by the logged-in Participant. Participants only.

200.description: Array of the participant's enrolments with event and category details.

delete.summary: Cancels an enrolment. Callable by the enrolled Participant or the Organiser who owns the event.
delete.description: The enrolment is kept with status Cancelled, which frees the place. It cannot be cancelled once a result exists.

403.description: Neither the enrolled participant nor the owning organiser.

409.description: A result has already been recorded for this enrolment.

get.summary: Lists all events, optionally filtered by date range or venue. Public.
get.description: Optional query parameters: from, to (dates, inclusive) and venueId. Ordered by date.

200.description: Array of events, each with its venue and categories.

post.summary: Creates a new event owned by the logged-in Organiser. Organisers only.
post.description:
Expects name, description (optional), eventDate (yyyy-MM-dd, not in the past), venueId
(the venue gives the event's location) and eventType (Run, Walk or Cycle).
Distances are defined per category.

201.description: Event created. Returns the event including its new ID.

400.description: Invalid data, unknown venue or date in the past.

get.summary: Returns the full details of one event, including its venue and categories. Public.

put.summary: Updates an event. Only the Organiser who owns the event may do this.
put.description: Expects the same body as event creation.

400.description: Invalid data, unknown venue or date moved into the past.

403.description: Participant, or an Organiser who does not own this event.

delete.summary: Deletes an event and its dependent categories, enrolments and results. Owner only.

403.description: Participant, or an Organiser who does not own this event.

post.summary: Records the finishing result for an enrolment. Only the Organiser who owns the event may do this.
post.description:
Expects finishTime (hh:mm:ss), position (1 or higher) and status (Finished, DNF or DQ).
finishTime and position are required when status is Finished. The enrolment must be confirmed.

201.description: Result recorded. Returns the result including its ID.

400.description: Invalid data, or the enrolment is cancelled.

403.description: Participant, or an Organiser who does not own the event.

409.description: A result already exists for this enrolment.

put.summary: Corrects an existing result. Only the Organiser who owns the event may do this.
put.description: Expects finishTime, position and status, as when recording a result.

403.description: Participant, or an Organiser who does not own the event.

get.summary: Returns the results (leaderboard) of a category, ordered by finishing position. Public.

200.description: Array of results; finishers first in position order, then DNF and DQ.

get.summary: Lists the logged-in Participant's own results across all events. Participants only.
Returns the profile of the logged-in user.

200.description: The user's ID, name, email, role and creation date (never the password).

put.summary: Updates the logged-in user's own name and email.
put.description: Expects name and email. The role cannot be changed.

409.description: The email belongs to another account.

get.summary: Returns another user's public profile (ID, name and role only).
Lists all venues so an Organiser can pick a venueId when creating an event.
get.description: Supporting endpoint added in Part 2 (not in the Part 1 plan). Read-only.

ApiError.description: Standard error body returned for 400, 401, 404 and 409 responses.

eventDate.description: Format yyyy-MM-dd. Cannot be in the past.

finishTime.description: Finishing time (hh:mm:ss). Required when Status is Finished.

position.description: Finishing position (1 or higher). Required when Status is Finished.
